assets.prompt_text:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square bust character portrait for a Chinese dark-fantasy action RPG HTML art-direction prototype.
Primary request: Make one square head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME reincarnator protagonist as reference image 1. The walking sprite sheet in image 1 is the primary and authoritative identity, costume, colors and illustration-style reference. Image 2 is supporting reference for identifying the same black-haired young adult Chinese man, but do NOT copy image 2's armor, black coat, upright collar, paper talismans, heavy photographic finish or luminous geometric background.
Subject: A serious but calm young adult Chinese male reincarnator. Preserve long black hair tied in a high topknot with the muted teal binding, loose black face-framing strands, dark eyebrows, clean-shaven face, age and slim athletic proportions. Reproduce the muted teal gray-green scarf around the neck, dark charcoal and faded blue-gray layered woven robe, brown leather cross-body strap, and the distinctive worn antique bronze shoulder guard on his own left shoulder as visible on the viewer's right in image 1. Clothing has believable worn cloth, old leather and subdued bronze textures.
Composition/framing: 1:1 square, a SINGLE character bust, facing slightly three-quarter toward viewer with an attentive neutral expression. Frame from upper chest to above the topknot. Keep the entire head and topknot inside the image, head and shoulders clearly readable, centered with modest breathing room. No sprite sheet, no turnaround, no grid, no additional people.
Style/medium: restrained realistic hand-painted fantasy game concept illustration matching image 1. Soft visible painterly edges and brushwork, natural facial anatomy with painted value shapes. Detailed but NOT a photo, photographic portrait, 3D render, anime cel-shading or glossy beauty treatment.
Scene/backdrop: simple opaque charcoal-gray and warm dark brown softly brushed atmospheric background, with no scenery, no ornament, no geometric portal.
Lighting/mood: soft diffuse directional light from upper left, gentle dark shadows, contemplative and weathered, coherent muted tones.
Color palette: low-saturation charcoal, desaturated teal and blue-gray cloth, brown leather, restrained old gold bronze accents. Avoid cyan glow or strong orange glow.
Constraints: Preserve the walking sprite identity and costume. Do not invent a different character. NO text, readable characters, UI, frame, icons, logo, watermark, captions, border or decorative motifs. No weapon in the crop. No giant armor, red costume, modern tactical gear or fantasy glow. Output an opaque square image.

visual_review.identity: Elderly East Asian female identity, facial proportions, mature eye wrinkles, gray-white braid, worn brown cloak, olive scarf and aged-brass compass brooch preserved. No young male features transferred from the style reference.
visual_review.composition: Square head-and-shoulders/upper-chest portrait and original framing preserved.
visual_review.palette: Low-saturation gray brown and old gold; soft illumination.
visual_review.style: Directed iteration visibly paints facial planes, hair and backdrop with brushwork and reduces photographic pores and gloss. More coherent with hero portrait than first candidate.
visual_review.deviation: Facial brush marks are somewhat more explicit than hero style reference, but remain a realistic painted portrait suitable for this HTML prototype.

iterations.prompt_text:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: square companion character portrait for a dark fantasy exploration game's HTML visual prototype.
Primary request: Create one square head-and-shoulders to upper-chest illustrated portrait of this SAME elderly East Asian female guide. Use the first reference's elderly identity and worn materials, with the second reference only as the existing portrait composition to improve. Preserve her mature, weathered face, gray-white hair gathered into a long braid over one shoulder, kind steady expression, old brown travel cloak, muted olive scarf and small aged-brass compass brooch.
Input images: Image 1 is the identity and clothing/material reference companion-guide-world-v1.png. Image 2 is the old portrait companion-guide-v1.png; preserve character identity but replace its photographic finish with coherent realistic hand-painted game concept art.
Scene/backdrop: Dark softly blurred brown-charcoal atmosphere with no identifiable objects.
Style/medium: Realistic hand-painted dark-fantasy game illustration with subtle painterly brushwork, convincing cloth and aged metal, tactile painted surfaces. Do NOT produce a photograph or photorealistic face.
Composition/framing: Exact square 1:1 image; centered head, both shoulders and upper chest visible; entire crown of hair visible with comfortable top margin; braid, scarf and worn cloak readable at thumbnail size. Calm three-quarter view similar to the references.
Lighting/mood: Gentle broad soft light, restrained contrast, compassionate experienced guide.
Color palette: Low-saturation gray-brown, dusty olive, restrained old gold. No neon colors or glowing effects.
Materials/textures: Weathered woven cloth and softened old leather, oxidized brass, gray-white strands of hair, natural age lines painted with care.
Constraints: Keep her visibly elderly, approximately 65–75; do not beautify into youth or erase her age. One character only. No weapons, no extra objects, no UI, no text, no border, no watermark. No glossy beauty photography, no anime, no flat vector art. Opaque background.

visual_review.identity: Elderly East Asian female identity, gray-white braid, worn brown cloak, olive scarf and aged-brass compass brooch preserved.
visual_review.composition: Square head-and-shoulders/upper-chest portrait; crown visible; dark brown charcoal background.
visual_review.palette: Low-saturation gray brown and old gold; soft illumination.
visual_review.deviation: Fabric and background show painterly handling, but highly detailed facial rendering retains some photographic feeling; use as prototype candidate, not final production approval.

iterations.prompt_text:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: one square companion character portrait for a hand-painted dark fantasy game.
Primary request: Make a single directed refinement to IMAGE 1, the elderly woman guide: repaint the face and hair into visible hand-painted realistic game concept illustration so the entire image matches the painterly language of IMAGE 2. IMAGE 2 is STYLE ONLY. Do not borrow its young male identity, clothing, colors, pose, or objects.
Edit target: IMAGE 1 guide portrait. Preserve her exact identity, elderly age, facial feature proportions and kind slight smile, head angle, gray-white long braid, brown worn cloak, olive scarf, aged-brass compass brooch, composition and square framing.
Style reference: IMAGE 2 hero portrait shows the coherent painted concept-art treatment desired. Use its deliberate broad modeled brush planes and broken painted edges across FACE as well as cloth. Express the woman's wrinkles and elderly anatomy with painterly strokes and shadow planes. Remove photographic skin pores, camera-like skin microtexture, glossy highlights, and fine photographic strand rendering. Paint hair in grouped gray-white strands and broken brushstrokes.
Keep: elderly woman visibly 65–75 with weathered face; do not beautify, smooth away age or make young. Preserve gray-brown and muted olive palette with old gold. Dark soft brown-charcoal backdrop, gentle soft light. One woman only.
Avoid: any photo or photography finish, photorealistic pores, glossy skin, young face, anime, flat cartoon, extra objects, text, UI, border, watermark. No alteration of clothing, jewelry, identity, pose or framing.
Output: exactly one opaque square 1:1 portrait image.
